saved-caller.evidence_boundary: Actual pinned FountainPen RTV4 constructor, Init, CreatePenCanvas, SetInverseScale, AddPoint, SendDataToGPU, Update, and Draw execute in Unicorn. The saved-caller capture replays the first three native AddPoint tuples from fixture v14_omitted; the separately labeled control uses explicit synthetic tuples. The probe constructs RTV4 directly and does not execute Drawing/Model admission. Color, canvas, queue/context/bitmap, and Draw matrices are explicit host inputs. GLES is Mesa via the existing host adapter. Readback is host-Mesa only, not Samsung device parity.
host_boundaries: Output bitmap comes from native SPGraphicsFactory::CreateBitmap with explicit RGBA8/RGBA target args, then actual SPTextureBitmap::AttachToCanvasRT(true).
The GL queue executes posted task vtable+16 synchronously in a host callback.
The Renderer-aware Unicorn loader and all GLES forwarding use host adapters.

The positive native Draw run replaces only the inherited host glDrawArraysInstanced diagnostic callback because that callback issues an invalid GL_RED read on this RGBA8 target; the replacement forwards the native draw and captures attribute state.
No Android app GL thread, natural object destruction, full Model/Drawing->RT lifecycle, or device GPU pixels are claimed.

input.kind: exact argument replay from native saved-caller fixture; not a captured device paint
input.queue: synchronous explicit host callback dispatching task vtable+16

saved-caller.paint_interpretation: The captured composite fragment shader writes vec4(uInputColor.rgb * alpha, alpha), so its RGB is premultiplied by the mask and color alpha; native Draw sets GL_BLEND with ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA. This describes the captured shader and GLES state, not a Samsung device compositing observation.

readback.origin: after actual native RTV4::Draw return, RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE read from host Mesa current FBO2; rows are GL bottom-up order

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec2 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec2 aCalcurateData; layout(location = 2) in vec4 aPointInfo; layout(location = 3) in vec2 aDirection; layout(location = 4) in float transparency; layout(location = 5) in vec2 AAInfo; uniform mat4 ProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; out float inputAlpha; out float innerRadius; out float alphaByWidth; void main(void) { vec2 normal; normal.x = aDirection.y; normal.y = -aDirection.x; vec2 position = aPointInfo.xy + aCalcurateData.x * (aDirection + normal * aCalcurateData.y) * aPointInfo.zw; gl_Position = ProjectionMatrix * vec4(position, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.x, aRectPoint.y); inputAlpha = transparency; innerRadius = AAInfo.x; alphaByWidth = AAInfo.y; }

#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; uniform vec4 inputColor; in vec2 fragCoord; in float inputAlpha; in float innerRadius; in float alphaByWidth; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); const float radius = 0.5; const float gradLength = 0.25; const float alphaRange = 0.93; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float distY = abs(center.y - fragCoord.y); float gradAlpha = clamp(1.0 - alphaRange / gradLength * (gradLength - (radius - distY)), 0.0, 1.0); float dist = distance(center, fragCoord); float alpha = alphaByWidth; if (dist > innerRadius) { alpha *= (1.0 - (dist - innerRadius) / (0.5 - innerRadius)); } float pointAlpha = inputAlpha * gradAlpha * alpha; FragColor = vec4(pointAlpha); }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec2 aVertex; out vec2 vUV; void main(void) { vUV = aVertex * 0.5 + 0.5; gl_Position = vec4(aVertex.xy, 0.0, 1.0); }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; uniform sampler2D uSrcTexture; uniform vec4 uInputColor; in vec2 vUV; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float alpha = texture(uSrcTexture, vUV).a * uInputColor.a; if (alpha > 0.0) FragColor = vec4(uInputColor.rgb * alpha, alpha); else discard; }

#version 300 es 
 precision highp float; layout(location = 0) in vec2 aRectPoint; layout(location = 1) in vec2 aCalcurateData; layout(location = 2) in vec4 aPointInfo; layout(location = 3) in vec2 aDirection; layout(location = 4) in float transparency; layout(location = 5) in vec2 AAInfo; uniform mat4 ProjectionMatrix; out vec2 fragCoord; out float inputAlpha; out float innerRadius; out float alphaByWidth; void main(void) { vec2 normal; normal.x = aDirection.y; normal.y = -aDirection.x; vec2 position = aPointInfo.xy + aCalcurateData.x * (aDirection + normal * aCalcurateData.y) * aPointInfo.zw; gl_Position = ProjectionMatrix * vec4(position, 0.0, 1.0); fragCoord = vec2(aRectPoint.x, aRectPoint.y); inputAlpha = transparency; innerRadius = AAInfo.x; alphaByWidth = AAInfo.y; }

#version 300 es 
 precision mediump float; uniform vec4 inputColor; in vec2 fragCoord; in float inputAlpha; in float innerRadius; in float alphaByWidth; vec2 center = vec2(0.5, 0.5); const float radius = 0.5; const float gradLength = 0.25; const float alphaRange = 0.93; out vec4 FragColor; void main(void) { float distY = abs(center.y - fragCoord.y); float gradAlpha = clamp(1.0 - alphaRange / gradLength * (gradLength - (radius - distY)), 0.0, 1.0); float dist = distance(center, fragCoord); float alpha = alphaByWidth; if (dist > innerRadius) { alpha *= (1.0 - (dist - innerRadius) / (0.5 - innerRadius)); } float pointAlpha = inputAlpha * gradAlpha * alpha; FragColor = vec4(inputColor.rgb, 1.0) * pointAlpha; }

precision highp float; uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix; attribute vec3 aVertex; varying float alphaAA; void main(void) { gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * vec4(aVertex.xy, 0.0, 1.0); alphaAA = aVertex.z; }

precision mediump float; varying float alphaAA; uniform vec4 uColor; uniform vec4 uTintColor; uniform int uHasTintColor; void main(void) { float alpha = alphaAA * uColor.a; if (uHasTintColor == 1) { alpha *= uTintColor.a; gl_FragColor = vec4(uTintColor.rgb * alpha, alpha); } else { gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor.rgb * alpha, alpha); } }
